items: Premium Corduroy Fabric – Unique Turtle-Back Texture - Wrapped in soft, durable corduroy with a distinctive turtle-back pattern, this sofa bed feels smooth and gentle on skin. The ridges add elegant texture while resisting wrinkles and daily wear. Blend seamlessly with any decor—ideal for families, pet owners, or anyone seeking lasting style and comfort.

No Assembly Needed – Vacuum-Packed for Easy Delivery - No tools, no setup. Simply unbox, pat the cushions, and allow 48 hours for full expansion. Important: Confirm you wish to keep the product before opening the vacuum bag—it cannot be recompressed. Once expanded, it’s ready to lounge on instantly. Hassle-free comfort from box to living room.

items.label: Dual-Layer Cushion Design – Removable & Washable Covers - Designed for easy care
items.value: the top seat cushion cover and backrest cover are both zippered and machine-washable. Simply unzip, wash, and freshen up your sofa anytime. Perfect for households with kids, pets, or frequent guests—hygiene and convenience built right in.

items: Wide Armrests with Built-In Cup Holders - Relax with extra-wide 10.8" armrests that provide ample support while reading, napping, or lounging. Each armrest features a convenient cup holder to keep drinks, remotes, or phones within easy reach. Smart functionality meets everyday comfort.

items.label: Space-Saving 50.6" Design – Fits Any Space, Any Moment - Compact yet generous
items.value: 50.6"W x 59.8"D x 34.3"H offers cozy two-person comfort in apartments, dorms, offices, or studios. Perfect for working from home, reading, napping, gaming, movie nights, or family moments. A versatile sleeper sofa that adapts to your lifestyle.
